title: Support Persons (Sahayak Vyakti)
summary: District Child Protection Unit, Rohtas invites applications from eligible candidates for the empanelment of Support Persons (Sahayak Vyakti) under POCSO Act 2012 and POCSO Rules 2020 for a period of 2 years. Candidates must submit their applications via email by December 24, 2026.
eligibility_bullets: Post-graduation in Social Work (MSV)/Sociology/Psychology/Child Development/Law, OR Graduation in any discipline with a diploma in Child Rights/Counseling along with 3 years of experience.
Must be a citizen of India and a resident of Rohtas district.
Clean criminal record with no pending criminal cases or moral turpitude.
how_to_apply_steps: Download the application form from the official Rohtas district website (rohtas.nic.in).
Attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates, caste certificate, character certificate, and residential proof.
Send the filled application form via email to adcp.rohtas@nic.in before 23:59 hours on December 24, 2026, mentioning the applied post name.
